# Nordify Liquid Glass (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/nordify/css-liquid-glass

Upstream revision: `00cfe6f9b15b72211853f190206bec6493907454`

The implementation is distributed under the MIT License; see `LICENSE`.
The TypeScript module import was made browser-module compatible (`./maps.js`), and the CSS import is linked separately. The refraction, nine-slice maps, reflection, edge lighting and resize logic remain the upstream implementation.

The browser modules in `/js/vendor/` are generated from these files by the build workflow.
